propertySets.name: Pset_SensorTypeWindSensor
propertySets.definition: A device that senses or detects wind speed and direction. HISTORY: Added in IFC4.

properties.name: WindSensorType
properties.definition: Enumeration that Identifies the types of wind sensors that can be specified.

properties.name: SetPointSpeed
properties.definition: The wind speed value to be sensed. Use IfcPropertyBoundedValue.SetPointValue to set the set point value.

properties.name: DampingRatio
properties.definition: Indicates the damping ratio of the device.

properties.name: SerialInterfaceType
properties.definition: Indicates the type of serial interface used by the device.

properties.name: MarginOfError
properties.definition: Indicates the margin of error of the measurement.

properties.name: LinearVelocityResolution
properties.definition: Indicates the resolution of the detected linear velocity.

properties.name: SamplingFrequency
properties.definition: Indicates the sampling frequency of the device.

properties.name: StartingWindSpeed
properties.definition: Indicates the starting wind speed of the wind sensor.

properties.name: WorkingState
properties.definition: Indicates the working state of device or system.

properties.name: TimeConstant
properties.definition: The time constant of the sensor.

properties.name: DataCollectionType
properties.definition: Indicates the type or manner of data collection.

properties.name: WindAngleRange
properties.definition: Indicates the wind angle range the sensor can monitor.

properties.name: WindSpeedRange
properties.definition: Indicates the range of wind speed the sensor can monitor.
